title: Build lines from the completed inspection screen, also on a phone
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  • A completed inspection with at least one Monitor or Not OK finding, run on a work order.
  • A phone (or a narrow browser window) available to repeat the flow.
custom_steps:
1. Open the completed inspection and confirm a Build lines action is offered.
2. Press it and check it opens the Build lines flow: choose the target work order, then the lines draft and you press Add Lines.
3. Repeat the whole flow on a phone without switching device.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The completed inspection screen offers a Build lines action.
  • The action runs the same build as S2, including the choice of target work order.
  • The action is usable on a phone, and the whole flow can be completed without switching device.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9101 (S3 — Build from a completed inspection); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S3; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R1: “The completed inspection screen will offer a Build lines action”
  • S3-R2: “The action will run the build described in S2, including the choice of target work order”
  • S3-R3: “The action will be usable on a phone, and the technician will be able to complete the whole flow without switching device”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
